arguments:
set +e
APP=/srv/lowcost-europa
ACCOUNT=le001_1789265592
printf 'OWNER=%s\n' "$(stat -c %U "$APP")"
printf 'HEAD='; sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'CHANGES_COUNT='; sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal | wc -l
for unit in lowcost-europa.service nginx.service postgresql.service lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.timer; do
  printf 'ACTIVE_%s=' "$unit"; systemctl is-active "$unit"
  printf 'ENABLED_%s=' "$unit"; systemctl is-enabled "$unit"
done
printf 'VENV='; if test -x "$APP/.venv/bin/python"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi
printf 'FREE_MB='; df -Pm "$APP" | awk 'NR==2{print $4}'
latest="$(sudo -n find /var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'lowcost-europa-*.dump' -printf '%T@ %f\n' | sort -nr | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)"
printf 'BACKUP_FILENAME=%s\n' "$latest"
dump="/var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily/$latest"
printf 'BACKUP_AGE_HOURS='; if test -f "$dump"; then echo $(( ($(date -u +%s)-$(sudo -n stat -c %Y "$dump"))/3600 )); else echo missing; fi
printf 'BACKUP_SHA='; sudo -n bash -c 'cd /var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily && sha256sum --status -c "$1.sha256"' bash "$latest" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail
printf 'BACKUP_RESTORE_INDEX='; sudo -n pg_restore --list "$dump" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail
printf 'OFFSITE_MARKER='; sudo -n test -f /var/lib/lowcost-europa/offsite-backup.last-success && echo present || echo missing
printf 'OFFSITE_AGE_HOURS='; sudo -n stat -c %Y /var/lib/lowcost-europa/offsite-backup.last-success >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo $(( ($(date -u +%s)-$(sudo -n stat -c %Y /var/lib/lowcost-europa/offsite-backup.last-success))/3600 )) || echo unknown
printf 'SUDO_WORKS='; sudo -n true && echo yes || echo no
printf 'RESULT=diagnostic_complete\n
